content.title: Home Studio Podcast Launch Quest
content.themeSummary: A creator campaign for planning, recording, editing, and publishing a polished first podcast episode from a home studio.
content.goalSummary: Launch a three-episode podcast pilot with a clear format, reliable recording workflow, and publish-ready audio.
safetyNotes: Avoid copyrighted music or clips unless proper rights are secured.
Get guest consent before recording and publishing conversations.

acts.title: Forge the Show Blueprint
acts.summary: Define the show promise, episode structure, guest plan, and recording setup before producing audio.

mainQuests.title: Write the Show Positioning Brief
mainQuests.description: Define the target listener, show promise, recurring segments, episode length, and what makes the pilot worth subscribing to.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A one-page positioning brief lists the target listener, show promise, format, and three pilot episode topics.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward strategic clarity before production work begins.

mainQuests.title: Run the Recording Rig Test
mainQuests.description: Configure microphone placement, recording software, backup capture, and room treatment, then record a test sample.
mainQuests.doneCondition: A five-minute test recording is captured, reviewed, and adjusted until levels and background noise are acceptable.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward reliable technical setup and audio capture discipline.

sideQuests.title: Prepare the Guest Outreach Kit
sideQuests.description: Draft a guest invitation, consent note, scheduling link, prep questions, and release expectations.
sideQuests.doneCondition: The outreach kit is ready and at least two potential guests have been contacted.

bossFights.title: Capture the First Raw Episode
bossFights.description: Record the full first episode using the show format, rig checklist, and backup recording process.
bossFights.doneCondition: A complete raw episode recording and backup file are saved in the project folder.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Reward the first major production milestone.

acts.title: Ship the Pilot Feed
acts.summary: Edit audio, package show assets, publish the feed, and run a launch review loop.

mainQuests.title: Build the Editing Pipeline
mainQuests.description: Create a repeatable process for cleanup, intro/outro placement, loudness normalization, show notes, and export naming.
mainQuests.doneCondition: The first episode is edited using a documented checklist and exported as a publish-ready file.

mainQuests.title: Publish Feed Assets
mainQuests.description: Create podcast artwork, title, description, categories, trailer copy, and hosting settings for the public feed.
mainQuests.doneCondition: The hosting platform has complete show metadata, artwork, and at least one scheduled episode.
mainQuests.rewardIntent: Reward packaging work that makes the podcast discoverable.

sideQuests.title: Run the Launch Feedback Loop
sideQuests.description: Share the pilot privately, collect listener feedback, identify confusing moments, and prioritize improvements.
sideQuests.doneCondition: At least five feedback notes are collected and converted into a prioritized improvement list.

bossFights.title: Release the Three-Episode Pilot
bossFights.description: Publish or schedule all three pilot episodes with consistent artwork, show notes, and launch messaging.
bossFights.doneCondition: Three pilot episodes are live or scheduled on the podcast feed and the launch announcement is posted.
bossFights.rewardIntent: Reward completing a coherent public launch.

skills.description: Package, announce, distribute, and improve a podcast based on listener feedback.
